findings.title: Scoped credential boundary has no production call site; evidence language overstates shipped behavior
findings.preconditions: Any real Moderate/Aggressive session at the reviewed commit
findings.failure_path: CredentialCapabilityStore::issue/consume and build_state_with_scoped_openai_credential are invoked only from #[cfg(test)] code; credential_broker defaults false (network-proxy/src/config.rs:162) and is not exposed in NetworkProxyConfigToml; children keep raw OPENAI_API_KEY
findings.recommendation: Wire the issuer path under a guard before claiming behavioral completion, or explicitly qualify all S01-S05 records as harness-invoked seam evidence pending PF-23 integration
findings.regression_test: End-to-end test from real session spawn proving dummy-only child env and exactly one live CONNECT/MITM injection

findings.title: No canary or Core evidence at the reviewed merge; full Core suite failed (135) and unattributed
findings.failure_path: Windows report is at ea7d4bec72, macOS/Linux at 55025dd42/27b738ab8; post-merge evidence is only 6 Python tests and doc checks; 135 Core failures (123 in codex-core::all) remain unwaived and unattributed
findings.recommendation: Re-run six-probe canary and targeted Core credential tests at 044491b8 on all three OSes; triage/fix the 135 Core failures before sign-off
findings.regression_test: CI gate binding canary report source_commit to the merged hash plus required Core suite result

findings.title: auth-helper posture gate resolves config via env-controlled CODEX_HOME
findings.preconditions: Agent can spawn processes with controlled environment
findings.failure_path: Persisted and override configs both honor CODEX_HOME; max() gate is bypassed if the agent supplies a home with permissive config; containment currently relies solely on keyring account being keyed by canonicalized home path (secrets/src/lib.rs:193), which is untested
findings.recommendation: Resolve posture from the canonical real home independent of env overrides, or bind and document the keyring-keying invariant
findings.regression_test: CLI test: alternate CODEX_HOME with permissive config and copied/symlinked vault must fail closed

findings.title: Secret passes through non-zeroized String temporaries during header construction
findings.preconditions: Any scoped or legacy broker injection
findings.failure_path: format!("Bearer {value}") creates an unzeroed heap String containing the secret; freed without wiping; HeaderValue not marked sensitive
findings.recommendation: Build header value inside Zeroizing<String> and mark HeaderValue sensitive

findings.title: Dummy values leak real secret length and punctuation layout to the child
findings.preconditions: Broker virtualization of any supported credential
findings.failure_path: shaped_dummy_value copies non-alphanumeric positions and length of the real secret into the dummy visible to the untrusted child
findings.recommendation: Use fixed-format random dummies independent of real-value shape
findings.regression_test: Matrix test asserting dummy shape independence from real-value shape

findings.title: Stale doc comment on normalize_label (claims lowercasing; code only trims)
findings.failure_path: Misdocumentation of a security-relevant label canonicalization function; behavior itself is consistent and fail-closed
findings.regression_test: Doc check or unit test pinning case-sensitivity semantics
